title: Honey Glaze Collagen Therapy Lip Mask
descriptionHtml:
✓ Ceramide✓ Clean at Sephora✓ High Shine Finish✓ allure 2026 Best of Beauty Award Winner✓ Collagen

What It Is: A deliciously scented, buttery lip mask powered by Mirsalehi honey and collagen for clinically backed hydration, soothing, and glazed shine.


Formulation: Lip Balm & Treatment


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Mirsalehi Honey and Bee Garden Oil Blend: Deep nourishment and glazed shine.

- Collagen Actives: Restores and smooths.

- Hyaluronic Acid: Provides lip fullness and long-lasting hydration.


Ingredient Callouts: It is cruelty-free.


What Else You Need to Know: This restorative formula is powered by Mirsalehi honey, collagen active, ceramides, and hyaluronic acid.

How to Use+

Suggested Use: 

-Glide on with the lip-hugging applicator. 

-Apply throughout the day for instant hydration and glazed shine. 

-Use as an overnight treatment for restored, smoother-looking lips.

Ingredients+
-Mirsalehi Honey and Bee Garden Oil Blend: Deep nourishment and glazed shine.
-Collagen Actives: Restores and smooths.
-Hyaluronic Acid: Provides lip fullness and long-lasting hydration.

Hydrogenated Poly(C6-14 Olefin), Diisostearyl Malate, Phytosteryl/Isostearyl/Cetyl/Stearyl/Behenyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Synthetic Wax, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Polybutene, Ethylene/Propylene/Styrene Copolymer, Isostearic Acid, Sucrose Tetrastearate Triacetate, Dilinoleic Acid/Propanediol Copolymer, Candelilla Cera (Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax, Cire de Candellila), Glycerin, Mel (Honey, Miel)*, Isostearyl Hydrolyzed Collagen, Ceramide NP, Sodium Hyaluronate, Tocopherol, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Limnanthes Alba (Meadowfoam) Seed Oil, Prunus Armeniaca (Apricot) Kernel Oil, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil, Glyceryl Caprylate, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Oenothera Biennis (Evening Primrose) Oil, Citrus Aurantium Bergamia (Bergamot) Fruit Extract, Calendula Officinalis Flower Extract, Daucus Carota Sativa (Carrot) Root Extract, Mauritia Flexuosa Fruit Oil, Glucomannan, Parfum (Fragrance), Trihydroxystearin, Butylene/Ethylene/Styrene Copolymer, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-di-t-butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Benzaldehyde**, Limonene**, Linalool**, Rose Ketones**, Vanillin**, Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499), Red 6 Lake (CI 15850), Red 7 Lake (CI 15850), Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140).

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
